scripts.db:migrate: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && cd apps/api && go run cmd/db/main.go migrate --signal SIGTERM
scripts.db:seed: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && cd apps/api && go run cmd/db/main.go seed --signal SIGTERM
scripts.build: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && concurrently "npm run build:api" "npm run build:web" "npm run build:deployment" "npm run build:monitoring"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && npx nodemon --exec go run ./cmd/server/main.go --signal SIGTERM
scripts.dev: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:deployment" "npm run dev:monitoring"
